title: SubscribedFrame
description: Server subscription acknowledgement frame. Carries per-topic forwarding cursor, current epoch, and last sequence watermark necessary for snapshot reconciliation.

topics.description: Map from subscribed topic name to its subscription cursor and sequence watermark state.

cursor.description: Transport replay cursor (e.g. Redis stream ID) from which live forwarding begins.

epoch.description: Current epoch of the topic at subscription time.

last_seq.description: Last sequence watermark recorded for this topic at subscription time.
